metrics.name: assertion_pass_rate
metrics.scorer_ref: agents/grader.md (from skill-creator) or manual assertion check
metrics.description: Fraction of pre-registered assertions that pass for a given run.

metrics.name: rubric_quality_score
metrics.description: 1-5 blind rubric score for dimensions assertions can't capture (clarity, tone, judgment).

metrics.name: token_efficiency
metrics.description: Mean tokens consumed per run, with stddev across repeats.

metrics.name: time_efficiency
metrics.description: Mean wall-clock duration per run, with stddev across repeats.

metrics.name: run_variance
metrics.description: Stddev of correctness/quality/efficiency across N repeats of the same prompt+configuration.

metrics.name: refinement_delta
metrics.description: L2-minus-L1 comparison: which assertions flipped, where quality changed and why, substance-vs-polish judgment, cost/benefit verdict.

_extend_by: Append a new object with name/axis/applies_to_layers/scorer_type/scorer_ref/description. scorer_type is one of: assertion (script-checkable), rubric (needs a blind judge prompt), derived (computed from other metrics' already-recorded data). No changes to SKILL.md's workflow steps are needed to pick up a new metric -- only the scorer implementation and this registry entry.
